title: 咖啡选择器
problem_statement_md:
一台咖啡自动售货机销售**5种咖啡**：

```text
1 - Latte
2 - Americano
3 - Espresso
4 - Cappuccino
5 - Macchiato
```

编写一个程序，输入客户选择的数字，并输出相应的咖啡类型。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]switch statement[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

A coffee vending machine makes [b]5 types of coffee[/b]:
1 - Latte
2 - Americano
3 - Espresso
4 - Cappuccino
5 - Macchiato

Write a program that  will take a number from the customer as input and serve the corresponding coffee type.

[b]Sample Input[/b]
2

[b]Sample Output[/b]
Americano

[note]Remember to terminate each case using the "break" statement. [/note]
hint_md: 记住要用 "break"语句来终止每个case；
